title: The Night the Drums Remembered Rain
description: At the driest point of the year, two festivalgoers wait beside the riverbed. An old drum answers with a sheet of rain that hangs above its skin.
alt: A glowing turquoise disk of rain hangs above a rope-laced drum as two people sit in a dry red canyon at dusk.
pairing: Dry-season river festival × a drum that remembers rain
